|url=http://www.icmrindia.org/casestudies/catalogue/Business%20Strategy2/Tata%20Consultancy%20Services%20Limited%20The%20Pioneer%20in%20the%20Indian%20IT%20Industry.htm |title=Tata Consultancy |url-status=live }} and offering bureau services to the [[Unit Trust of India]]. In 1975, TCS implemented an electronic depository and trading system named SECOM for [[Switzerland|Swiss]] company SIS SegaInterSettle. It also developed System X for the Canadian Depository System and automated the [[Johannesburg Stock Exchange]].{{cite web |url=http://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/archive.html?siteSect=883&sid=957178&ty=st |archive-url=https://archive.today/20120912080537/http://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/archive.html?siteSect=883&sid=957178&ty=st |url-status=dead |archive-date=12 September 2012 |title=Indian software keeps Swiss securities safe |publisher=Swissinfo.com |date=14 January 2002}} TCS also partnered with the Swiss firm TKS Teknosoft, which it later acquired.{{cite web |url=http://www.financialexpress.com/news/tcs-acquires-swiss-firm-tksteknosoft/182435/ |title=TCS acquires TKS Teknosoft |work=The Financial Express |date=11 January 2006 |access-date=16 February 2009 |archive-date=28 December 2013 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131228050802/http://www.financialexpress.com/news/tcs-acquires-swiss-firm-tksteknosoft/182435 |url-status=live }} In 1980, TCS established India's first dedicated software research and development center, the [[Tata Research Development and Design Centre]] (TRDDC), located in [[Pune]].{{Cite journal |last=Kanavi |first=Shivanand |title=Megasoft |journal=Business India |pages=46–54 |date=20 June 2004}} The following year, it created India's first client-dedicated [[offshore development centre]], established for [[Tandem Computers|Tandem]]. Anticipating the [[Year 2000 problem|Y2K bug]] and the introduction of the unified European currency ([[Euro]]), Tata Consultancy Services developed a factory model for Y2K conversion. action lawsuits === In 2006, the US law firm Lieff Cabraser filed a class action lawsuit against TCS on behalf of non-US citizens employed in California between 2002 and 2005. The plaintiffs alleged they were compelled to endorse their federal and state tax refunds to the company and faced unauthorized deductions from their US pay. In February 2013, TCS agreed to a $30 million settlement, which was granted final approval by Judge Claudia Wilken of the US District Court for the Northern District of California in July 2013.{{cite web |url=http://www.lieffcabraser.com/Case-Center/Tata-Workers-in-America-Wages-Class-Action-Lawsuit.shtml |title=Tata Workers in America Wages Class Action Lawsuit |work=Lieff Cabraser Heimann & Bernstein, LLP |access-date=2 July 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131030054357/http://www.lieffcabraser.com/Case-Center/Tata-Workers-in-America-Wages-Class-Action-Lawsuit.shtml |archive-date=30 October 2013 |url-status=dead}}{{cite news |title=TCS to pay $30 million to settle employee class action suit in US |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/ites/tcs-to-pay-30-million-to-settle-employee-class-action-suit-in-us/articleshow/18701530.cms |work=The Economic Times |date=28 February 2013 |access-date=15 April 2026}} In 2024, TCS became the subject of multiple putative class-action lawsuits and a formal probe by the US Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) regarding discriminatory hiring and firing practices. TCS has consistently denied these allegations, stating its employment decisions are based on performance and business restructuring needs rather than national origin or age.{{cite news |title=TCS under fire in US for being biased towards Indian staff, laying off Americans; IT major calls claims 'meritless' |url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/tcs-under-fire-in-us-for-being-biased-towards-indian-staff-laying-off-americans-it-major-calls-claims-meritless-11744884840100.html |work=Mint |access-date=15 April 2026}} === 2026 Nashik BPO workplace harassment case === {{main|2026 Nashik BPO workplace harassment case}} In early 2026, multiple employees at the Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) campus in Nashik, Maharashtra, filed First Information Reports (FIRs) alleging sustained sexual harassment and religious coercion by several team leaders. By mid-April 2026, authorities had registered nine FIRs and arrested seven employees, including several team leaders and an Assistant General Manager of Human Resources. The SIT investigation highlighted an alleged failure of the facility's internal grievance mechanisms. Police reported that the HR executive was arrested for explicitly ignoring dozens of written complaints, emails, and chat messages from the victims, thereby failing to trigger mandatory POSH (Prevention of Sexual Harassment) protocols.{{cite news |title=How six women cops went undercover to probe rape, sex abuse charges at TCS in Nashik |url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news/how-six-women-cops-went-undercover-to-probe-rape-sex-abuse-charges-at-nashik-bpo-101776060006736.html |work=Hindustan Times |date=13 April 2026 |access-date=15 April 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260415091500/https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news/how-six-women-cops-went-undercover-to-probe-rape-sex-abuse-charges-at-nashik-bpo-101776060006736.html |archive-date=15 April 2026 |url-status=live}} TCS suspended the accused employees and initiated an investigation.{{cite news |title=POSH failure at TCS Nashik? Tata Consultancy Services Limited (TCS) is an Indian multinational technology company specializing in information technology services and consulting. Headquartered in Mumbai, it is a part of the Tata Group and operates in 150 locations across 46 countries. As of 2024, Tata Sons owned 71.74% of TCS, and close to 80% of Tata Sons' dividend income came from TCS.
TCS ranked seventh on the Fortune India 500 list for 2024. In September 2021, TCS recorded a market capitalization of US$200 billion, becoming the first Indian IT company to achieve this valuation. However, its market capitalization declined to under US$100 billion in June 2026. In 2012, it was the world's second-largest user of U.S. H-1B visas.
